rapport_notes: Rep maintains professional tone and responsiveness but lacks warmth, enthusiasm, or personalization; mostly transactional.
process_discipline_notes: No repetitions detected; no silence violations observed (though the call ends abruptly without a formal close).

evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: "basically we just wanted to ask you some information in order for us to give you a perfect code. Is it a convenient time to talk?" — frames the ask but does not explicitly time-box or promise an accurate quote in return.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Never asked. Rep launches directly into logistics probing (address, bedrooms, parking, access, boxes) without asking what Cedric's biggest concerns or priorities are for this move.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: When Cedric explains he wants to do some of the packing himself and move over three days before using movers on Thursday, rep responds only with "Less" and "Mm-hmm" — acknowledges but does not probe deeper into the implications or timeline concerns.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: "So, we will be based on your home size, normally it would take three movers and one truck. The estimated time is between six and a half to eight and a half hours and the estimated cost in case they end up eight and a half hours, would be $2,716." — gives range and personalizes to 3-mover/truck fit.
evidence_quotes.estimate_is_a_window: "It does not necessarily mean that you're locked in for eight and a half hours. That would still really depends on how well prepared you are." — clearly explains estimate is a window based on customer prep.
evidence_quotes.self_prep_tip: "in case if you still have extra time just to prepare but in the small items into your boxes yourself that would really help to keep the time down in your efficiency up." — advises pre-packing as a cost/time saver.
evidence_quotes.close: Call ends with "Feel free to shop around" and Cedric saying he'll call back. No rate-lock line stated, no explicit booking ask made.

top_strength: Rep successfully routed a large move (3,400 sq ft destination) to a virtual walkthrough as intended, and provided a clear, range-anchored estimate with personalization (3 movers, 6.5–8.5 hrs) when the customer declined the walkthrough.
coaching_note: Before diving into logistics, ask Cedric's agenda first ("Other than price, what are your biggest concerns about this move?") — that will surface his timeline/prep strategy upfront and let you probe deeper into what matters most to him, rather than asking generic questions and moving on.
